phaseIntent: Define how the production normalization corpus is processed at scale — deterministically, in isolation, with auditability. This gate authorizes the batch CONTRACT only. Batch EXECUTION is NOT authorized.
batchQuestion: How do we safely process the remaining production corpus at scale?
pilotQuestionAnsweredSeparately: Does the pipeline behave safely when it encounters different knowledge outcomes? — YES (pilot GREEN)
notAuthorizingYet: Pilot re-run or pilot closure reversal

cohortManifestFreeze.rule: Cohort manifest must be immutable for the run via content hash — manifest edits between authorization and execution invalidate the batchRunId
cohortManifestFreeze.resumeRule: Resume rejects manifestHash or cohortHash mismatch — HARD STOP

ingest.scope: PDF extract, extraction doc, procedure seeds where applicable

normalize.scope: Candidate extraction per manual into isolated candidate directory

branches.label: canonical_mapping
branches.description: One or more mapping candidates bind to frozen canonical vocabulary without distortion
branches.note: Candidate only — human gate required for any promotion

branches.label: implementation_specific
branches.description: Overlay candidates and/or compound terms — OEM implementation vocabulary

branches.label: architecture_exception
branches.description: Cannot map without canonical distortion — STOP forward batch progress

manualDispositionModel.replacesPilotField: pipelineDisposition alone is insufficient for production audit

primaryDisposition.rule: Single primary outcome for batch ordering and STOP semantics — the highest-precedence terminal state for the manual

hasCanonicalMappings.rule: true when candidate mapping count > 0 — orthogonal to primaryDisposition

hasUnresolvedTerms.rule: true when UNRESOLVED_TERM count > 0 or conflicts present

hasArchitectureException.rule: true when architecture_exception.json exists or is detected

promotionBlocked.rule: true when unresolved, conflicts, or architecture_exception

pilotSemanticFix.problem: Pilot allowed implementation_specific while also having canonical candidate mappings and unresolved terms
pilotSemanticFix.resolution: primaryDisposition uses precedence; boolean flags preserve full audit trail

provenance.contentHash: SHA-256 of normalized candidate inputs — idempotency key

candidateDirectoryIsolation.rule: Each manual writes only to normalization/candidates/{manualId}/

unresolvedIsolation.rule: UNRESOLVED_TERM in manual A must not alter mapping candidates in manual B
unresolvedIsolation.enforcement: Per-manual candidate files; no shared mutable normalization state

architectureExceptionIsolation.rule: architecture_exception on manual A must not be copied, inferred, or applied to manual B
architectureExceptionIsolation.enforcement: Exception artifact scoped to manualId directory only
architectureExceptionIsolation.flexwashExample: SAMSUNG-FLEXWASH-WASHER STOP does not imply STOP for other Samsung washers

frozenCanonicalImmutability.rule: frozen canonical graphs remain immutable during batch
enforcement: batch hard STOP on hash mutation

noCrossManufacturerInference.rule: Mapping evidence from manufacturer A must not auto-resolve terms for manufacturer B
noCrossManufacturerInference.enforcement: Per-manual provenance; no batch-wide term promotion

noTopologyInference.rule: Product topology (dual-load, AIO, stacked) must not be inferred from make/model string alone
noTopologyInference.enforcement: architecture_exception route when distortion detected — not silent multi-instance mapping

forbidden: manufacturer_overlays/*.json without separate overlay publish gate

batchStopSemantics.summary: Architecture exception stops FORWARD batch progress. Completed manuals are retained. Pending manuals are not processed. No silent continuation.

onArchitectureException.trigger: hasArchitectureException=true for current manual during batch run

priorCompletedManuals.note: Already-safe results from earlier manuals in the same batch run are immutable

subsequentManuals.reason: Batch run halted — await human review and explicit resume authorization

onArchitectureException.stopReasonTemplate: architecture_exception on {manualId} — batch forward progress STOP per batch contract

pilotBehaviorDifference.pilot: pilot_batch.py breaks loop on first architecture_exception — same forward halt semantics
pilotBehaviorDifference.batch: Explicit retention of completed manuals + pending queue + human review — not implicit
pilotBehaviorDifference.improvementRequired: Batch orchestrator must emit per-manual audit manifest and batch checkpoint — not only aggregate results

flexwashSpecialCase.expectedBehavior: architecture_exception STOP — even though integration boundary is frozen
flexwashSpecialCase.rationale: Production pipeline must not bypass historical exception; FlexWash normalization is separate authorized workstream

manualProcessingKey.rule: Same inputs → skip re-normalization unless --force-manual flag with human authorization

completedManualRerun.rule: Rerunning a completed manual must not duplicate candidates
completedManualRerun.behavior: Skip if audit manifest shows batchState=completed and contentHash unchanged
completedManualRerun.forceRequires: explicit --force-manual + human authorization recorded in batch audit

resumeAfterStop.rule: Resume must not mutate prior approved results
resumeAfterStop.behavior: Start from first pending manual; stopped_trigger manual requires human clearance before reprocessing

deterministicIdentity: candidate file paths under manualId directory

specialCohortHandling.note: Frozen AIO composition — map by reference, not duplication

pilotCheckpointManuals.description: Eight pilot manuals have baseline dispositions from CG_PRODUCTION_NORMALIZATION_PILOT_RESULTS_v1.json — batch must not silently overwrite without explicit force

executionGateCriteria.note: Orchestrator implemented — explicit human authorization for batch execution remains the only open gate
required: Regression suite for batch contract + execution
Explicit human authorization for batch execution

stopCondition: Contract definition GREEN authorizes batch EXECUTION gate design — not batch execution itself.
